AxisGIS – Town of Carlisle Disclaimer

The Town of Carlisle acquires, develops, maintains, and uses GIS data to support its internal functions and the public services it provides. The information shown on this map is from the Carlisle Geographic Information System (GIS) database and is intended for informational purposes only. The data is not suitable for legal, engineering, or surveying purposes. Specifically, the data may not represent the result of an on-the-ground survey and may represent only the approximate or relative location of property boundaries. Source information used for the data may have been collected at different scales, times, or definitions, resulting in inconsistencies among features represented together within a GIS data product. All data are subject to change and periodic updates; the GIS data presented herein may not represent the most current information available.

The current parcel level data was derived from a prior CAD digitization. Town staff are aware that errors and inconsistencies exist regarding both dimension labeling and parcel configurations. An audit is being conducted and we anticipate corrections will be made in January 2025.

Actual wetland boundaries must be determined on the ground by a wetlands scientist. Wetlands may be more extensive than shown or may be missing from the GIS data.
